notes:
A formal word meaning a class or category of things, or the extent of a particular sphere. Originally a philosophical term borrowed from Chinese, now widely used in formal writing and speech to indicate whether something falls within or outside a particular classification.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {範疇|はんちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: fall within the scope
- {範疇|はんちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: exceed the scope
- {範疇|はんちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: be included in the category
- {範疇|はんちゅう}⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧: outside the scope

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧: range, scope — more general and less formal
- ⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧: field, area — emphasizes the subject domain rather than boundaries
- ⟦カテゴリー→カテゴリー：10819_kategorii⟧: category — the loanword equivalent, used in casual contexts
